name: Timeline (five milestones)
author: PrismNext
description: A single axis with five alternating above/below milestone labels.

parameters.name: \eonelabel
parameters.meaning: first milestone (use \\ for a second line)

operations.summary: add a tick on the axis and an above/below label; keep alternating sides
change a style's palette name; never a hex/stock color

invariants: preserve tick names (e1)–(e5) unless the user dropped that event
colors only via the five palette names
